observations: Workflow explicitly checks out the PR head or push SHA and the helper checks actual Git HEAD before quarantine; command ids remain unique serial fixed producers. Original ten SQL commands are split into equivalent fail-fast serial steps.

Preparation precedes dependency install/all producers, removes exactly48 designated stale report outputs after saving verified originals, and retains/backups two auxiliary inputs. No arbitrary command execution exists inside the collector.

Source before/after snapshots bind tracked bytes and executable modes, deny staged/untracked unrelated changes, and permit only the fixed output set to differ. Unchanged source is checked before any report payload is copied.

Artifact copies only fixed JSON report paths and source hash snapshots; failed/skipped/cancelled/unknown producers remain partial/pending, missing/invalid reports cannot produce complete evidence, and untrusted step outputs/errors are discarded.
Numeric exit codes remain null and every result retains pending qualification with a mandatory external final GitHub run/job/step API gate; no collector success is a domain qualification verdict.

Original byte/mode restoration is identity/byte-guarded and the final exact full Git snapshot must equal the pre-test snapshot. Quarantine and newly created directories are synced before unlinking outputs.

Report symlinks and unsafe entries are refused without following their target. Run/attempt roots and collection are one-use; artifacts use a fixed run/attempt name, pinned upload action, no overwrite and short retention.

Focused tests cover missing/softened producers, stale reports, invalid UTF8/JSON, preparation failure, source drift, symlinks, one-use ownership and restoration. I inspected these tests; their14passing execution was reported by the author, not independently rerun by this reviewer.
limits: This is an independent source review, not hosted candidate execution or actual PostgreSQL qualification.
Final artifact acceptance still requires exact candidate/run/attempt API metadata, artifact digest, all final steps/jobs success and separate report/domain/source/cleanup validation.
Controlled CI filesystem checkpoints are not hostile concurrent filesystem isolation; no native provider, key, merchant, deployment or browser-engine claim.
